question: The Zo-Mal-Lok folk dance is associated with which community?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Lepcha community.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Zo-Mal-Lok:-**

 
 
• **It is a folk dance is associated with the Lepcha community of Sikkim and Darjeeling. **
 
• It is a group dance that is performed to celebrate the agricultural cycle of paddy cultivation.
 
• The dance is performed by both men and women, who wear traditional Lepcha costumes and dance to the accompaniment of traditional Lepcha musical instruments such as the tungbuk (bamboo flute), yangjey (stringed instrument), cymbal, and drum.
 
 
 
• **Lepcha community:-**
 
 
• This community is an indigenous people of the Himalayan region, with a population of around 11,000.
 
• They are found primarily in the state of Sikkim in India, as well as in neighboring parts of Bhutan, Nepal, and West Bengal.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jamatia community:-**

 
 
• **It is one of the 19 indigenous tribes of Tripura, a state in northeastern India. **
 
• They are the third largest tribe in the state, with a population of over 83,000.
 
• The Jamatias are also found in neighboring Bangladesh and Myanmar.
 
 
 
• **Chaimal community:-**
 
 
• **The Chaimal community is a small indigenous tribe of Tripura, a state in northeastern India. **
 
• Their total population is only about 550 people, and they are primarily concentrated in the Ambassa subdivision of the Dhalai district.
 
 
 
• **Lushai community:-**
 
 
• **The Lushai community, also known as the Mizo community, is an indigenous people of Northeast India and neighboring parts of Bangladesh and Myanmar. **
 
• They are the largest ethnic group in the Indian state of Mizoram.
